name: Orderfacts.ordercount within HLL tolerance (count_distinct is approximate)
referenceSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT o.c_order_id) AS value FROM c_order o JOIN c_orderline ol ON ol.c_order_id=o.c_order_id WHERE o.ad_client_id=1000026 AND o.processed='Y' AND o.isproposal='N' AND o.dateordered >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.dateordered < DATE '2026-09-01'
